question: Take something you did for fun recently. Can you give me an example of what it took to keep your attention on it?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: Keeping score at softball is a good example. I could follow the game from start to finish and keep track of the substitutions without having to keep pulling my attention back. The substitutions take a bit of concentration, but that’s part of the job.
